# Cognacity

> > Cognacity combines neuroscience and psychology to advance mental health awareness, workplace wellbeing, and high-performance resilience across professional and sporting contexts.

Cognacity is a mental health and psychological resilience organization that partners with professional sports organizations and enterprises to deliver evidence-based mental health support. The platform focuses on understanding cognitive biases, stress management, and psychological resilience through a neuroscience-informed approach.

## Key Topics

- Mental health awareness
- Neuroscience
- Cognitive bias
- Stress and burnout
- Psychological resilience
- Men's mental health
- Suicidal ideation prevention
- Workplace wellbeing
- High-performance psychology
- Threat detection
- Superstition and amygdala response
- Decision-making
- DP World Tour partnership
- Mental Health UK
- Your Mind Matters

## Mental Health Partnerships & Campaigns

- [Cognacity - Official Mental Health Supplier of the DP World Tour](https://www.cognacity.co.uk/2025/09/09/cognacity-official-mental-health-supplier-to-dpworldtour): Announces Cognacity's partnership with DP World Tour as official mental health supplier, bringing psychological resilience support to professional golf.

## Men's Mental Health & Crisis Awareness

- [1-in-3 Men Experience Suicidal Thoughts Brought On By Stress](https://www.cognacity.co.uk/2025/11/26/1-in-3-men-experience-suicidal-thoughts-brought-on-by-stress): Men's mental health awareness article addressing stress-induced suicidal ideation and the importance of psychological support during mental health crises.

## Neuroscience & Cognitive Psychology

- [Why Friday 13th still gets inside your head](https://www.cognacity.co.uk/2026/02/13/why-friday-13th-still-gets-inside-your-head): Explores negativity bias and amygdala response to superstitions, demonstrating how evolutionary threat-detection mechanisms influence modern decision-making and psychological resilience.
